title: Sushi roll with a smiling face
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- outer nori wrap -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='52' r='34' fill='#3b2f6b'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='52' r='34' fill='none' stroke='#5a4a9e' stroke-width='2'/>
  <!-- rice ring -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='52' r='28' fill='#f7f3e3'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='52' r='28' fill='none' stroke='#ffffff' stroke-width='2'/>
  <!-- rice grain texture -->
  <circle cx='38' cy='36' r='2.5' fill='#e8e2cc'/>
  <circle cx='62' cy='38' r='2.5' fill='#e8e2cc'/>
  <circle cx='34' cy='54' r='2.5' fill='#e8e2cc'/>
  <circle cx='66' cy='56' r='2.5' fill='#e8e2cc'/>
  <circle cx='42' cy='68' r='2.5' fill='#e8e2cc'/>
  <circle cx='58' cy='68' r='2.5' fill='#e8e2cc'/>
  <!-- filling: salmon -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='52' r='15' fill='#ff8a5c'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='52' r='15' fill='none' stroke='#ffb48a' stroke-width='2'/>
  <!-- cucumber -->
  <circle cx='44' cy='48' r='5' fill='#6fcf6f'/>
  <circle cx='44' cy='48' r='5' fill='none' stroke='#a3e8a3' stroke-width='1.5'/>
  <!-- avocado -->
  <circle cx='57' cy='55' r='5.5' fill='#b8e05a'/>
  <circle cx='57' cy='55' r='5.5' fill='none' stroke='#d6f08a' stroke-width='1.5'/>
  <!-- eyes -->
  <circle cx='43' cy='44' r='3.5' fill='#2b2340'/>
  <circle cx='57' cy='44' r='3.5' fill='#2b2340'/>
  <circle cx='44' cy='43' r='1.2' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <circle cx='58' cy='43' r='1.2' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <!-- smile -->
  <path d='M42 54 Q50 62 58 54' fill='none' stroke='#2b2340' stroke-width='2.5' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- blush -->
  <circle cx='36' cy='53' r='3' fill='#ff9ea8' opacity='0.8'/>
  <circle cx='64' cy='53' r='3' fill='#ff9ea8' opacity='0.8'/>
</svg>
